Nina: Mini oddball poll for the offsite: what's one tiny thing you pack that feels dumb but has saved you? no toiletries.
Omar: A tiny rubber band ball. everything gets bundled: headphones, cords, even the badge lanyard. :rubber_band:
Kelly: A credit-card folding wallet (thin metal). doubles as a coaster in flaky hotel rooms and a makeshift shim for wobbly tables.
Tess: Shoe deodorizer sachets in shoes. they actually keep the whole bag smelling decent after a day of walking.
Hiro: I carry a clear zip snack bag. use it for wet socks, chargers, or a spill. so many uses.
Nina: Omar where do you keep the rubber bands? pocket or bag?
Omar: In an altoids tin with a couple paperclips. fits in laptop pocket.
Kelly: Pro tip: carry a small printed tile with hotel breakfast times & wifi steps. saves the 3am panic.
Tess: For flights: bring a lightweight scarf that doubles as a blanket, pillow wrap, or dress-up scarf for panels.
Hiro: Quick hack for plugs: a 2-port USB wall adapter instead of multiple cables. less outlets hogged.
Nina: Poll: react :one: for rubber band kit, :two: metal wallet/coaster, :three: scarf/sachet/snackbag (pick main)
Omar: :one:
Kelly: :two:
Tess: :three: (scarf)
Hiro: :three: (snackbag)
Nina: Great. Ill add these to the offsite "what to pack" card and share. also leaving this thread pinned for future flights. thanks folks!
